title: Advanced Characterization of Materials at the Nanoscale Using SIMS
content: Obtaining nanoscale insights into material composition and transformations requires advanced characterization tools with exceptional lateral resolution and sensitivity [1,2]. The combination of Focused Ion Beam (FIB) systems with dedicated magnetic sector Secondary Ion Mass Spectrometry (SIMS) offers a powerful solution for high-resolution 2D and 3D chemical imaging, depth profiling, and isotopic compositional mapping with spatial resolution below 20 nm.
